meta.title: GastroHub | Your restaurant's own ordering website
meta.description: GastroHub builds your restaurant its own website with online ordering and table reservations. Your guests order directly from you instead of through delivery apps. Three models from €50/month, online in 2 to 4 weeks.

hero.subline: GastroHub builds your restaurant its own website where guests order and reserve tables directly with you. You pay a predictable monthly price, not 13 to 30% of every order to a delivery app.

live_restaurants.title: Our designs
live_restaurants.subtitle: Four restaurants selling through GastroHub today, each with its own domain, its own design and its own menu. Click a card and you're in the real shop.
live_restaurants.cta_card_body: Free first call, online within a few weeks.

features.title: And everything that comes with it
features.subtitle: Extra features on your own website.
features.ki_text: One click in the dashboard: the AI writes the full order to your supplier, as email or WhatsApp, in the right language.
features.admin_text: Accept orders, manage delivery zones, opening hours, coupons and staff, all from your phone.
features.lang_text: Available in German, English, Arabic and Turkish, more languages on request.
features.printer_text: Your restaurant gets its own tablet with a thermal printer. When an order comes in, you see it on the tablet, print it right away, and the money goes straight to your account.
features.reports_text: A weekly report on your sales by email, ready to print or forward to your accountant.

pricing.meta_description: Three pricing models for the GastroHub restaurant platform: Digital (€300 one-off plus €25/month), Entry (€50/month) or Flatrate (€100/month, tablet and printer included).
pricing.title: Simple pricing models
pricing.subtitle: Three models that grow with your restaurant. Start small, switch anytime.
pricing.einmal_b1: Your own website with a digital menu
pricing.einmal_b2: QR code for tables and your shop window
pricing.einmal_b3: Your own email address on your domain (e.g. info@yourrestaurant.de)
pricing.flat_b3: Your own website, menu, QR code and email address included
pricing.flat_b4: Includes €1,000 of online revenue per month*
pricing.p5_b1: Online orders and table reservations by email
pricing.p5_b3: Your own website, menu, QR code and email address included
pricing.footnote: *Flatrate: above €1,000 of monthly online order revenue, €25 is added per further €1,000 started. For comparison: delivery apps take 13 to 30% of every order. All prices are plus 19% VAT.

how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: You focus on the kitchen, we take care of the rest.
how.step1_body: Drop us a short message. In the first call we sort out your setup and the right model, no commitment and no cost.
how.step2_body: We take over your menu, photos and texts, build your website and set up your tablet and printer. After 2 to 4 weeks everything is online.
how.illustration_subtitle: We walk you through the setup
how.step4_body: Your guests order their favorite food through your website, you manage everything in the dashboard.
how.step3_body: Start telling your customers about your new site. We add it to your Google Business profile and design a brochure with a QR code you hand out with every order, so next time guests scan it and feel motivated to order through your site instead of delivery apps.

final_cta.title: What are you waiting for?
final_cta.subline: Get in touch or give us a call. It's free, and we'll be happy to help and answer all your questions.

benefits.title: Why your own website instead of delivery apps?
benefits.subtitle: Keep your revenue and your profits. You don't have to share them with anyone just so your guests can order from you.
benefits.card2_title: The guest is yours, not the app's
benefits.card2_body: You see names, emails and order history, and can reach your guests for repeat orders and promotions. On delivery apps the customer belongs to the app.
benefits.card3_body: Your own website with your menu improves your Google ranking. Guests find you in local search when they look for food nearby.
benefits.card4_body: Most guests would rather order from the restaurant itself: cheaper prices, easier ordering, and they support their local. You just have to make it possible.
benefits.card5_title: Let your guests book their table
benefits.card5_body: Table reservations run directly through your site, without phone chaos at peak times, in the language you prefer.
benefits.card6_body: Larger orders from offices and groups land directly with you. A proper website with a clear menu looks professional, especially to business customers.
benefits.card1_body: On delivery apps, €1,000 in sales currently costs you at least €160. With your own website, nobody shares your profits.
